section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the objectives and hypotheses of the current study, which examines how exposure to body-focused versus non-body-focused others relates to college women's body image and eating both between-persons (over a week) and within-persons (day-to-day and within-day). It specifies hypotheses 1a/1b for between-persons associations, 2a/2b for within-persons (daily) associations, and hypothesis 3 predicting that changes in exposure will prospectively predict subsequent eating and body image but not vice versa.
